Quick answers up front: we generally apply PLG trial credits at account level; if the invoice was generated before credits were applied, it can show a charge and then be reissued. VAT treatment depends on the tax info we have on file.

Neha — can you (1) confirm whether the $3,000 trial credit was attached to ACME's account and the date it was applied, (2) check whether the invoice on 2026-07-31 can be reissued with credits applied, and (3) advise on VAT given Samantha supplied a VAT number during signup (Samantha, if you can attach the VAT certificate that helps expedite).

- Trial credit of $3,000 was provisioned on 2026-07-05 and is visible in the account balance.
- The invoice dated 2026-07-31 was auto-generated at 00:00 UTC and did not include the credit because the billing job snapped the pre-credit balance (a timing edge case).
- We can reissue the invoice to show the credit and reduce the charge to $0.00; alternatively we can issue a one-time invoice credit/adjustment.

VAT: I do not yet see the VAT certificate attached to the account. If ACME is VAT-registered in the EU and provided a valid VAT number, we will zero-rate the VAT for B2B transactions. If you can attach the VAT registration document, we'll update the tax profile and reissue.

I'll mark this as high priority and aim to reissue within 48 hours after receiving the docs.
